description: The card expiry date provided is in the past, or the card has lapsed with the issuer.
official_next_step: Ask the customer to enter an active, non-expired card or choose an alternate payment instrument.

description: The card number failed the Luhn checksum algorithm or has an invalid BIN range.
official_next_step: Prompt customer to verify the 16-digit card number printed on the physical/virtual card.

description: The card issuing bank declined the authorization request due to internal risk, credit limit breach, or disabled e-commerce permissions.
official_next_step: Customer must enable online / e-commerce transactions in their bank's mobile app or try a different card.

description: Card CVV/CVC verification failed at the card network switch.
official_next_step: Prompt the customer to enter the 3-digit CVV printed on the back of the card (or 4-digit for Amex).

description: 3D Secure 2-Factor OTP verification failed or was abandoned before completion.
official_next_step: Retry payment and ensure the OTP received via SMS is entered before the countdown expires.

description: The card presented is issued by an international entity and international payments are disabled on the merchant account.
official_next_step: Customer should use a domestic Indian card/UPI, or merchant must enable international card processing in Razorpay Dashboard.

description: e-NACH / UPI Autopay recurring debit attempt exceeded the registered mandate frequency schedule.
official_next_step: Schedule recurring debit in alignment with the registered mandate cycle (monthly/quarterly) or send on-demand invoice link.

description: The recurring e-Mandate was revoked or cancelled by the customer via their netbanking/UPI portal.
official_next_step: Request customer to re-authorize a new e-Mandate or switch to manual B2B invoice settlement.

description: The customer's netbanking portal session timed out prior to transaction submission.
official_next_step: Advise customer to re-initiate payment and complete bank authentication in an active browser tab.

description: Prepaid wallet balance is insufficient to cover the invoice payment.
official_next_step: Prompt customer to top-up wallet or choose UPI / Netbanking / Corporate VAN.

description: Maximum consecutive failed authorization attempts reached for this session.
official_next_step: Cooldown session for 30 minutes or issue a fresh payment link.

description: The acquiring or issuing bank returned an unhandled technical failure code.
official_next_step: Retry the payment with the same idempotency key or switch payment method.

description: Network connectivity between Razorpay and downstream payment aggregator/network interrupted.
official_next_step: Retry after a brief delay. Razorpay auto-retries transient network drops.
